start.speaker: Patient
start.text: You a doctor? No... you've got the look of a man asking questions instead of answering them.

n1.speaker: Patient
n1.text: Ask, then. I've got nothing but time and tremors.

sick.speaker: Patient
sick.text: Worked the harbor twenty years. Now my hands won't hold a cup and the left eye's gone dark. Doc says it's the water. Whole block's the same. City's calling it a bad season.

discover.title: The Sick Ward
discover.desc: A dockworker, half-blind, hands shaking — poisoned by the harbor water. He says his whole block has it. This is the human cost of KZ-7, filed away as 'a bad season.'

bye.speaker: Patient
bye.text: ...Find whoever did this to us. Please.
